sources.title: Camper Fuzz — Croy Tone Audio Technologies
sources.excerpt: Croy Tone Audio Technologies describes the Camper Fuzz as a versatile silicon fuzz inspired by classic 1960s and 1970s fuzz sounds. The builder says the Camper Fuzz is the third version of a fuzz design begun in 2016, with a flexible tone section intended to cover heavy 1970s wall-of-fuzz sounds through sharper late-1960s lead tones. The product page says the pedals are hand assembled in the CroyTone Audio Shiroishi Shop in Sapporo, Japan and use true-bypass switching.

sources.title: Croy Tone Audio - Camper Fuzz | Reverb
sources.excerpt: A Reverb listing identifies the exact Croy Tone Audio Camper Fuzz and describes it as a used pedal from Croytone Audio. The listing states that the unit was made in the USA before the company moved to Japan and includes multiple photos of the exact listed pedal. This provides independent identification of the Camper Fuzz model alongside the current manufacturer product page.
